blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Remote work depends on a few simple things at the same time. You need a reliable internet connection. You need a company laptop with the right software. You need a VPN for safe access. You need good headphones for calls. And you need a habit of starting and ending the day at consistent times.

The IT side is usually the easy part. The harder part is the discipline. You must keep work and home separate. You must take breaks. You should close the laptop at a sensible hour. And you should raise small problems before they become big ones.

Remote work does not make people less productive. It just makes productivity depend more on habits than on office walls. Good habits in a quiet room beat bad habits in a noisy office every time.

items.q: According to the text, what is usually the easy part of remote work?
items.why: "The IT side is usually the easy part."

items.q: What does the text say is the harder part?
items.why: "The harder part is the discipline."

items.q: According to the text, remote work makes productivity depend more on…
items.why: "it just makes productivity depend more on habits than on office walls."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which statement?
options: A VPN helps with safe access.
You should take breaks during the day.
Good habits matter for remote work.
Remote work always makes people less productive.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz o contrário — "Remote work does not make people less productive."

items.q: "Raise small problems before they become big ones" suggests that…
options: you should hide problems from IT
small problems can grow if you wait
items.why: Inferência: falar cedo evita que um problema pequeno vire um grande.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie orientando um novo colega que vai trabalhar de casa. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the team. Your laptop is ready, and the VPN is already set up, so the tools are the easy part. Let's talk about the habits.

My first tip: start and end your day at the same times. When there is no office, your calendar is the wall. If you keep no clear hours, work never really stops, and that is not good for you.

Second: take real breaks. Stand up, get some water, look out of the window. A short break helps you think better. You do not have to sit for eight hours.

Third: when something small breaks — the VPN, your headphones, a slow connection — tell IT the same day. A small problem is quick to fix. A big one is not.

And one more thing. Close the laptop at a sensible hour. A quiet room and good habits beat a noisy office every time. You will be fine. Just ask me anything you need.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: According to Sophie, what is the easy part?
options: The tools, like the laptop and the VPN
items.why: "the tools are the easy part."

items.q: What is Sophie's first tip?
options: Work eight hours in a row
Start and end the day at the same times
items.why: "start and end your day at the same times."

items.q: When something small breaks, what should the new joiner do?
items.why: "tell IT the same day."

items.q: What does Sophie mean by "your calendar is the wall"?
options: The calendar sets your work hours at home
You must hang a calendar on the wall
The office wall has a calendar
items.why: Inferência: sem paredes de escritório, o calendário é o que marca começo e fim do dia.

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela dá boas-vindas, dá dicas e diz "You will be fine. Just ask me anything."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We need a reliable internet connection for calls." Reliable means…
options: that you can trust; it works well
items.why: Reliable = confiável, que funciona bem quando você precisa.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please use your ___ for the meeting so people hear you clearly."
items.why: Headphones = fones de ouvido, o que você usa nas chamadas.

items.q: "She starts work at the same time every day. She is very consistent." Consistent means…
items.why: Consistent = consistente, que se mantém igual dia após dia.

items.q: "If you have a problem with the VPN, please raise it with IT." To raise a problem means to…
items.why: To raise = levantar, trazer o assunto para alguém resolver.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Good habits at home can help your ___, so you get more done."
items.why: Productivity = produtividade, quanto você consegue produzir.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem no trabalho remoto do dia a dia. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I will log in to the VPN before the meeting." To log in means to…
options: enter a system with your password
items.why: Log in = entrar num sistema com usuário e senha.

items.q: "Let's set up the laptop before your first day." To set up means to…
options: prepare it so it is ready to use
items.why: Set up = configurar, deixar pronto para usar.

items.q: "Can you turn off your microphone when you are not talking?" To turn off means to…
items.why: Turn off = desligar.

items.q: "IT will sort out your VPN problem today." To sort out means to…
items.why: Sort out = resolver, arrumar.

items.q: "Let's catch up on a quick call this afternoon." To catch up means to…
items.why: Catch up = colocar o papo em dia, conversar sobre novidades.
